correctness.rationale: The 90 indexed words have composition (2,2,2); unequal adjacent swaps give the stated graph metric. Radius-one balls are disjoint exactly at minimum distance at least three (use the midpoint of a path of length two in the converse). Independent enumeration checked the listed 18-word construction at distance three and the nine orbits of distance-at-most-two cliques under relabeling and reversal. Their 72 distinct cliques have total integer weight 360 and cover every vertex with integer weight at least 19. An independent set uses at most one vertex per clique, so integer incidence counting gives |C| ≤ floor(360/19)=18. The exhibited code thus attains the optimum.
residual_risks: The computation is exhaustive only for this one composition and metric parameter; no uniqueness or all-optima classification is asserted. Frozen executables were inspected, not executed.
